title: [GMCP 203.011.05] Interoperability and quality: Complete prompt and completion server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-011-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Prompt discovery/get and argument completion implement all current schemas, roles, embedded content, pagination/filtering, list changes, cache semantics, validation, cancellation, authorization, and deterministic ranking. Prompt templates are immutable per advertised version, untrusted substitutions remain data, and injection, oversized expansion, missing argument, localization, and concurrent-update cases are proven. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
